'''Jump Ships''' carry their own [[Gate Drive]], allowing journeys beyond the fixed [[Quantum Gates|gate network]]. They transport survey teams, urgent dispatches and small cargoes that cannot wait for a public departure slot.

== Design ==
A reinforced hull surrounds the drive and its energy stores. The ship must prepare an independent navigation solution; a route recorded by another captain is useful evidence but not an automatic clearance. Long recharge periods make conventional gates preferable for ordinary commerce.

== Service ==
[[Tide Spindle]] repairs civilian ships without asking their crews to join a faction. Its engineers are studying the damaged log brought back from [[Silent Reach]], hoping to find a cause other than deliberate interference.
